checks.name: wrong tenant principal and unknown/unbound routes refuse reads and writes
concurrent retries commit once; receipts are tenant-local; changed-content reuse conflicts
batch conflict rolls back earlier rows and receipt
JSON null/missing and numeric/string predicates remain distinct
stable date/id pagination and indexed date query
tombstone survives resend and does not affect the other tenant
parallel distinct writes do not lose records
one synthetic CGM day per each of 32 tenants
SIGTERM restart preserves acknowledged documents, tombstones, cell IDs and receipts
SIGKILL restart preserves acknowledged documents, tombstones, cell IDs and receipts

limitations: Not the Nightscout storage adapter or API; no MongoDB/PostgreSQL parity claim.
Local process restart is not node/disk loss, fleet replication, or RPO=0 proof.
Loopback microbenchmark; no production tenant capacity or hosting cost inference.
Synthetic fixed principals, no production identity integration or real health records.
